_comment: Personal preferences (not secrets). Copy this to preferences.json and edit to make ScribeJay yours — preferences.json is gitignored, so your real details never reach the repo. Restart any running task/launchd job after editing.

learnings._comment: What the daily learnings reviews ignore. excluded_domains is matched on the domain and its subdomains, so 'sharepoint.com' covers 'tenant.sharepoint.com'. excluded_keywords are case-insensitive substrings matched against calendar event summaries, browsed-site titles, and page paths.
